src/reyn/runtime/session.py.note: Session.run_one_iteration's _turn_owner_task (session.py:6937) -- a real funnel bypass (raw asyncio.create_task, not routed through TrackedTaskSet), measured and judged not dangerous (#5300 re-type: the gate was right to flag it, only the 'defect' danger-judgment was wrong -- this is not a false_positive). The funnel is for tasks that outlive their creating call; this one is awaited at :6942 and discarded at :7013. Two grounds, both checked in #5267: (a) a driver cancelled by ANY route does cancel it -- Task.cancel() propagates through _fut_waiter, measured on a minimal repro and on a real Session, falsifying the orphaning hazard this entry was first typed 'defect' for; (b) quiescence is already covered without the funnel -- await_quiescent's own docstring calls its list 'the exhaustive set of append-capable spawned tasks in this surface' and names 'the current turn (_turn_idle)' first. Re-type to 'defect' only if a reproduction of an actually-orphaned turn task appears.
